idea-plugin.name: Cloud9 JetStream
idea-plugin.description:
Cloud9 JetStream

A dark theme for JetBrains IDEs built for long coding sessions. Deep navy-black backgrounds, restrained Cloud9-blue accents, and a palette that stays out of your way.

Design philosophy

Most dark themes settle for flat charcoal. Cloud9 JetStream uses a layered navy-black palette with five distinct background tiers from #060A10 through #1E293B, so the editor, tool windows, and popups feel like distinct surfaces, not one blob of gray.

The color story is deliberately restrained:

  • Blue carries syntax structure: keywords, operators, focus indicators
  • Cyan marks type information: classes, types, interfaces
  • Purple/violet/indigo flag meta-language: annotations, constants, decorators
  • Amber is reserved for strings. One warm accent. Like stars against a dark sky.
  • Steel-blue punctuation that recedes so logic stands out

Every color has a job. No competing accents.

What's covered

  • 90+ syntax tokens
  • Language-specific tuning for Kotlin, Java, Python, JS/TS, SQL, CSS, Shell/Bash
  • Every UI surface: main menu, tool windows, completion, run widget, terminal, debugger, VCS log
  • Tuned console ANSI palette
  • Rainbow brackets cascade (blue → cyan → indigo → violet → purple)
  • File-status colors that make VCS changes legible at a glance
